anchor_text: 01 Learn the foundations From the first executable to ownership, data modeling, and a working event counter. 8 lessons ↗
02 Build reliable programs Borrowed interfaces, purposeful traits, bounded input, and tests that matter. 6 lessons ↗
03 Understand concurrent work Shared state, threads, synchronization, futures, and the runtime underneath async. 6 lessons ↗

01 Set up your Rust workshop Install a reproducible toolchain, read a Cargo project, and make the first edit. 35 min · Read, run, practice ↗
02 Values, functions, and control flow Express decisions with types, functions, matching, and explicit numeric boundaries. 45 min · Read, run, practice ↗
03 Ownership, places, and moves Track who owns a value and why passing it can make its old location unavailable. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
04 Borrowing and reborrowing Reason about permitted access over time instead of treating references as spare owners. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
05 Strings, slices, and collections Use UTF-8 deliberately and choose ownership at collection boundaries. 45 min · Read, run, practice ↗
06 Structs, enums, and useful states Make domain distinctions visible without building an elaborate type architecture. 45 min · Read, run, practice ↗
07 Errors as part of the interface Distinguish malformed input, missing values, broken assumptions, and operational failure. 50 min · Read, run, practice ↗
08 Stage build: the first event counter Combine control flow and borrowed text into a small working program. 70 min · Read, run, practice ↗
09 Lifetimes describe relationships Design borrowed results without pretending annotations extend storage. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
10 Traits where abstraction earns its place Use standard interfaces, associated types, and dispatch intentionally. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
11 Iterators and closures without hidden ownership Read item types, captures, laziness, and short-circuiting results. 45 min · Read, run, practice ↗
12 Stage build: a bounded streaming library Separate parsing from I/O and enforce memory limits before input grows. 90 min · Read, run, practice ↗
13 Cargo, modules, and dependency boundaries Read the actual workspace, feature graph, lockfile, and release configuration. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
14 Tests, diagnostics, and complementary tools Test contracts and failures, and use compiler output without inventing it. 60 min · Read, run, practice ↗
15 Interior mutability and shared ownership Distinguish reference counts, runtime borrowing, and synchronization. 50 min · Read, run, practice ↗
16 Threads, Send, and Sync Transfer or borrow work safely while keeping completion and failure explicit. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
17 Channels, locks, and shutdown Choose ownership transfer or shared state, and reason about waiting. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
18 Atomics and memory ordering Separate an indivisible counter update from publication of other data. 60 min · Read, run, practice ↗
19 Futures before runtimes Understand polling, wakeups, state machines, and what await does not promise. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
20 Tokio tasks, blocking, and cancellation Use a runtime with bounded queues, explicit task results, and deliberate shutdown. 70 min · Read, run, practice ↗
21 Pin and async trait boundaries Understand address-sensitive values and stable alternatives to native async dyn dispatch. 65 min · Read, run, practice ↗
22 Stage build: an async ingestion pipeline Keep one owner of the aggregate while producers hand over bounded work. 80 min · Read, run, practice ↗
23 Unsafe boundaries and soundness Audit one small abstraction with explicit invariants, edge cases, and Miri. 85 min · Read, run, practice ↗
24 Measure performance and resource use Build a reproducible experiment before changing allocation, dispatch, or build profiles. 60 min · Read, run, practice ↗
25 Stable Rust and the horizon Read current initiatives without turning goals, experiments, or compiler limitations into stable promises. 60 min · Read, run, practice ↗
26 FFI, serialization, and public contracts Design boundaries where Rust types alone cannot validate the other side. 55 min · Read, run, practice ↗
27 Capstone: ship Fieldnotes Assemble the tested parser and bounded reader into an installable command-line product. 150 min · Read, run, practice ↗
28 Release, maintain, and keep learning Review a public API, reproduce a release, and maintain the course's evidence. 60 min · Read, run, practice ↗
